Added one-shot native reservation, handler-registration, and dispatch fault injection
Poisoned post-handler failures and allowed teardown only after explicit terminal stream proof
Suppressed timing publication for work that never reached the dispatch boundary
Made command-buffer scope and absence of a performance claim explicit
Wired the diagnostic into the leased one-copy native COW probe so the surface has an operational receipt consumer
validation: Static native-source checks for callback-only collection and bounded storage
Focused failure-atomicity tests for reservation rollback, terminal-gated abort, non-underflow, and false-publication refusal
Fresh Release native build and ABI import against the pinned MLX wheel
